Body.Content:
We have created documentation to describe how Azure Stack infrastructure satisfies regulatory technical controls for PCI-DSS and CSA-CCM. Azure Stack operators can use this documentation to simplify the process companies go through when working with governing bodies.

Learn more about Compliance certification.

Learn more about Azure Stack security, compliance, and identity.

Get more information about the key features and concepts in Azure Stack.
